core.inspect.meaning: Observe metadata or structure without changing the target.
preconditions: target exists or optional target handling is declared

core.read.meaning: Retrieve accessible exact content without changing its source.

core.analyze.meaning: Derive stated findings from declared input.
postconditions: findings distinguish observed facts from inference

core.calculate.meaning: Compute a result from declared values and rules.

core.compare.meaning: Compare artifacts or values against exact criteria.
preconditions: both operands are accessible and criteria are type-valid

core.filter.meaning: Return members satisfying a predicate while preserving order.
postconditions: source order is preserved for LIST
all and only TRUE members are returned

core.sort.meaning: Return LIST[T] in one declared deterministic total order from LIST[T] or SET[T].

key.meaning: Optional total-order projection; STRING is one exact property_path and REFERENCE is one validated kind.operation extractor.
constraints: Omission is legal only when every pair of target members is mutually order-compatible under operators_and_functions_v0.1.0.json#/ordered_types.
A STRING is exactly one property_path defined for every target member.
A REFERENCE resolves to a kind.operation with SIDE_EFFECT FALSE, DETERMINISTIC TRUE, exactly one PARAMETER accepting T, and exactly one RESULT of a concrete registered ordered type.
Every key value is present, known, and mutually order-compatible; distinct SET members produce distinct keys.
descending reverses primary-key order without reversing original LIST source order among equal-key members

preconditions: an omitted key requires mutually order-compatible target members
a declared key is defined for every member and produces present, known, mutually order-compatible values
distinct SET members produce distinct keys
postconditions: the result contains exactly the target members, preserving LIST multiplicity and including each SET member once
ordering follows the natural value or declared key and direction
equal-key LIST members retain original LIST source order

diagnostic_triggers.error.operation.parameter: An unknown, duplicate, or mistyped parameter; stable or comparator; invalid direction; malformed property_path; or invalid key-extractor signature.
diagnostic_triggers.error.reference.unresolved: The key REFERENCE does not resolve exactly once.
diagnostic_triggers.error.reference.kind: The key REFERENCE resolves to a declaration other than kind.operation.
diagnostic_triggers.error.required.missing: A declared key value is MISSING for any member.
diagnostic_triggers.error.value.unknown: A declared key value is UNKNOWN for any member.
diagnostic_triggers.error.operation.precondition: An omitted key lacks natural total order, key values are not mutually order-compatible, or distinct SET members produce equal keys.

core.group.meaning: Partition values by one declared key or predicate.
preconditions: key is defined for every member
postconditions: every input member occurs in exactly one group

core.validate.meaning: Check syntax, type, reference, dependency, and constraints before effects.
preconditions: validation has no external side effect
postconditions: all detected failures use registered error identifiers
result records TRUE, FALSE, or UNKNOWN and evidence

core.test.meaning: Execute one declared test and compare ACTUAL with EXPECTED.
preconditions: exactly assertion or expected+actual mode is supplied

core.report.meaning: Produce a factual report from declared results and evidence.
postconditions: report distinguishes facts, inference, missing, and unknown

core.return.meaning: Return declared OUTPUT values to the invoking channel.
postconditions: returned value equals resolved target value

core.create.meaning: Create a new target that does not already exist.
preconditions: target does not exist when fail_if_exists is TRUE
at least content or target_type is supplied

core.write.meaning: Establish or replace complete content of an authorized target.
preconditions: target exists unless create_if_missing is TRUE
postconditions: complete target content equals content parameter

core.append.meaning: Add content at the declared end of an authorized target.
postconditions: pre-state is unchanged prefix and content is exact suffix

core.modify.meaning: Change selected content or properties of an existing target.

core.copy.meaning: Create a new target containing an exact copy of a source.
preconditions: destination absent unless overwrite is TRUE

core.move.meaning: Relocate a target without changing declared content.
preconditions: destination absent unless overwrite is TRUE
postconditions: source no longer exists at original address

core.rename.meaning: Change a target identifier/path name without changing content.
postconditions: content and non-name properties are preserved

preconditions: target exists unless require_exists is FALSE
recursive deletion is explicitly authorized when needed

core.generate.meaning: Produce a new artifact from declared input and constraints.
postconditions: artifact satisfies specification and declared verification

core.convert.meaning: Produce an artifact in a declared target type or format.
postconditions: output has target_format and preserved properties

core.execute.meaning: Run an exact command, program, task, phase, sequence, or action.

core.install.meaning: Add declared software or resources to an external environment.
preconditions: package identity and source are unambiguous
postconditions: declared package/resource is installed at requested version

core.start.meaning: Put a process or service into running state.
postconditions: target reaches running/ready state or fails explicitly

core.stop.meaning: Terminate the selected path, process, or service.

core.send.meaning: Transmit declared content to an external recipient or endpoint.
postconditions: delivery result and recipient are recorded
only declared content is available at destination with exact visibility

core.upload.meaning: Transfer declared content to an external destination.

core.download.meaning: Transfer declared content from an external source into scope.

core.memory_write.meaning: Create or update explicitly authorized persistent memory data.

merge.meaning: Merge object fields instead of replace.

core.ask.meaning: Request one exact missing value from an available authoritative source.
postconditions: answer is recorded and type-valid or remains MISSING

core.retry.meaning: Repeat the associated action under RETRY LIMIT and WHEN.

core.continue.meaning: Continue a bounded path after a handled event.
preconditions: current event is handled and continuation path exists
postconditions: execution resumes at exact declared successor

core.cancel.meaning: Terminate because the invoking authority cancelled execution.
